headline_claim: Summer uses response-oracle training to create complementary latent team strategies inside one decentralized PPO policy, then learns a persistent context router that selects among them and outperforms fixed-strategy and matched non-latent PPO agents.

architecture.note: Current run uses shared z-conditioned critic (z one-hot), not separate value heads. Do not change mid-run. Per-z value heads are a Phase-1 retry option only if tiny-KL basin failure.

failure_responses_one_each.delta_G_le_0_tiny_KL: One retry with more branch freedom or budget — literal one retry
failure_responses_one_each.large_KL_no_target: Stop OP×map specialization; move to possession/phase contexts
failure_responses_one_each.two_fair_rounds_flat: Redesign strategic regimes, not PPO machinery

proof_ladder: 1 Stage-1 creates one latent response: delta_G > 0
2 Confirm across seeds + larger eval: CI95(delta_G) > 0
3 Add another response only if G increases again (2–3 specialists enough)
4 Verify single policy retains repertoire: G_available_internal > 0
6 Routed LRO-Summer > matched non-latent PPO: G_latent > 0
closed_paths: soft OP×map mixtures as primary birth

implicit_vs_explicit_foresight.current_ladder_phases_1_to_6: empirically learned latent values + temporal context = implicit foresight only
implicit_vs_explicit_foresight.explicit_choreography_requires: V_hat(c_t,z) or multi-feature future predictors (possession, flag threat, spread, survival, score, return) compared across candidate z
implicit_vs_explicit_foresight.status: OPTIONAL post-ladder extension — not a Phase 1–6 gate; do not insert before G_available>0 and G_realized>0

stage1_progress_note.gate: success = delta_G = G_after - G_before > 0; G_after>0 alone is insufficient if G_before already >0
paper_confirm_metrics: raw win rate and score outcomes
shaped payoff used for LRO targeting
stage1_progress_note.early_cells_are_directional_only: 4 eps/cell; OP11 map1 z3 75% vs others 50% is one-episode noise until locked
